### Autorelease {#gaa746cc945a11e1a90abcd9b6dab3e509}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Look for an `‘autorelease`' instruction dependent on Arg such that there are / no instructions dependent on Arg that need a positive ref count in between / the autorelease and the ret.</p>

<dl class="doxySectionUser">
<dt>Initialiser</dt>
<dd>
<div class="doxyVerbatim">=
        FindPredecessorAutoreleaseWithSafePath(Arg, &amp;BB, Ret, PA)
</div>
</dd>
</dl>


<p>static <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/callinst">CallInst</a> * FindPredecessorAutoreleaseWithSafePath(const Value *Arg, BasicBlock *BB,
                                       ReturnInst *Ret,
                                       ProvenanceAnalysis &amp;PA) { <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/smallptrset">SmallPtrSet&lt;Instruction *, 4&gt;</a> DepInsts; auto *Autorelease = dyn_cast_or_null&lt;CallInst&gt;(
      findSingleDependency(NeedsPositiveRetainCount, Arg, BB, Ret, PA));</p>


<p>if (!Autorelease) return nullptr; <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/objcarc/#a494b44abeacdfac8bb26d3203571d1c2">ARCInstKind</a> AutoreleaseClass = GetBasicARCInstKind(Autorelease); if (!IsAutorelease(AutoreleaseClass)) return nullptr; if (GetArgRCIdentityRoot(Autorelease) != Arg) return nullptr;</p>


<p>return Autorelease; }</p>


<p>/ Look for this pattern: /</p>


<div class="doxyProgramListing">

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">///    %call = call i8* @something(...)</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">///    %2 = call i8* @objc_retain(i8* %call)</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">///    %3 = call i8* @objc_autorelease(i8* %2)</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">///    ret i8* %3</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyNoLineNumber">&nbsp;</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">/// </span></span></div>

</div>


<p>/ And delete the retain and autorelease. void ObjCARCOpt::OptimizeReturns(Function &amp;F) { if (!F.getReturnType()-&gt;<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/#a7db94a9fa353cc7a297edd4e8601b184">isPointerTy()</a>) return;</p>


<p>LLVM_DEBUG(<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/#a7c46c742c31be54870e2038048e6b391">dbgs()</a> &lt;&lt; "\n== ObjCARCOpt::OptimizeReturns ==\n");</p>


<p>for (<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/basicblock">BasicBlock</a> &amp;BB: F) { <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/returninst">ReturnInst</a> *Ret = dyn_cast&lt;ReturnInst&gt;(&amp;BB.back()); if (!Ret) continue;</p>


<p>LLVM_DEBUG(<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/#a7c46c742c31be54870e2038048e6b391">dbgs()</a> &lt;&lt; "Visiting: " &lt;&lt; *Ret &lt;&lt; "\n");</p>
